name: Custom Shape Wooden Pen Box with Drawer
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a sturdy, practical, and charming desktop storage solution.
    - Features a custom shape wooden pen box with drawer design that combines decorative appeal with everyday functionality.
    - Made from 3mm thick wood, creating a lightweight yet durable structure for long-term use.
    - Includes a pull-out drawer and upper storage compartment for organizing pens, pencils, and small desk essentials.
    - Layered front decoration adds a personalized and eye-catching touch to the finished design.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall product size:
              +) Width: 4.5 in ~ 11.5 cm
              +) Height: 5.7 in ~ 14.5 cm
              +) Depth: 3.3 in ~ 8.38 cm
    - Upper storage compartment:
              +) Width: 2.9 in ~ 7.4 cm
              +) Height: 1.1 in ~ 3 cm
    - Drawer size:
              +) Width: 3.9 in ~ 10 cm
              +) Depth: 2.8 in ~ 7.1 cm
              +) Height: 1.8 in ~ 4.7 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Each wooden part is printed as follows:
              +) Box – 2-sided printing
              +) Drawer (included back, bottom, side) – 2-sided printing
              +) Drawer Front (included layer 1, layer 2 and layer 3) – 1-sided printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized desk organizer and a decorative storage box.
    - Designed to hold pens, pencils, rulers, markers, erasers, and other small stationery items.
    - The upper compartment provides quick access storage, while the drawer offers extra space for organizing small supplies.
    - Suitable for study desks, classroom tables, office desks, and home workspaces.
    - Perfect for keeping everyday desk essentials neat, accessible, and attractively displayed.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for students, teachers, kids, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for back-to-school gifts, birthdays, teacher appreciation, classroom rewards, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for study spaces, classroom desks, office organization, and personalized stationery collections.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who loves cute desk accessories and practical personalized items.
    - Great for school supplies, desktop décor, and daily organization.
    - Adds a fun, useful, and personal touch to any workspace 🎁

 

  • Assembly Instructions:
    - Step 1: Prepare all wooden panels and printed pieces.
    - Step 2: Assemble the main box structure by connecting the side panels, back panel, and base panels.
    - Step 3: Assemble the drawer pieces, including the drawer sides, drawer back, drawer bottom, and drawer front.
    - Step 4: Slide the completed drawer into the lower compartment of the box.
    - Step 5: Make sure all parts are aligned securely before use.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Pen Box with Drawer

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
